root_groups.cause: The PR36 source corrections for protected WordPress auth/admin/REST routes and redirect chains were not integrated into PR40 and must not disappear; duplicate review number R1675–1714 on distinct draft branches is not a new independent audit.
root_groups.correction: Reapply existing approved narrow source guards and retained previously tested PR36 regression on top of PR40.

root_groups.cause: The legacy migration validator distinguished '/old' and '/old/' as unrelated source paths; an executed migration relied only on stored ready state and checksum without rechecking current route owner/chain safety guards.
root_groups.correction: Detect slash-equivalent source identity collision; re-run the full current validator immediately before activating stored ready map, requiring exact sorted/matched approved map.

root_groups.cause: Accepted File25 materialized timeline index with positive items could declare no canonical owner versions. Source-version map had no explicit entry or field-length limits, so a provider filter could submit excessive metadata into a WordPress index option.
root_groups.correction: Reject positive items with empty owner provenance; reject >64 source owners, >64-byte owner keys or >64-byte source versions, while continuing to allow valid File21 owner version identifiers.
